decks.notes: This deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex early on to slow down opponent's strategies. The hatebears are supported by cards like Archon of Emeria and Trinisphere to further disrupt the opponent's spells and mana base. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Anointed Peacekeeper for removal and protection. The deck aims to establish board presence quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory in a fast-paced Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key cards such as Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to facilitate this process, the deck can consistently bring back threats like Ichorid and Hollow One from the graveyard. The inclusion of cards like Creeping Chill and Silversmote Ghoul provide additional value when cards are milled. The deck also features disruption in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Combo - Doomsday deck focuses on assembling the necessary cards to efficiently use the Doomsday spell, which allows the player to rearrange their library and win the game on the spot. The deck includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Time Walk to generate card advantage and mana acceleration, along with disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo. With tools like Necropotence, Demonic Tutor, and Thassa's Oracle to help assemble the combo pieces, the deck aims to win quickly and efficiently.

This Vintage MUD deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts like Mishra's Workshop, Lodestone Golem, and Crucible of Worlds to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to slow down the opponent's plays. The deck aims to generate mana efficiently with cards like Mana Vault, Sol Ring, and the Moxes, while also utilizing cards like Phyrexian Revoker and Nettlecyst to deal with threats. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Urza's Saga provide additional value and card advantage in this aggressive artifact-based strategy.

This deck focuses on using powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Time Walk to quickly advance the game while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The inclusion of the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for additional value by recurring low-cost permanent cards like Mishra's Bauble and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending while maintaining card advantage through cantrips and card draw spells.

The key strategy of this deck revolves around quickly getting out an Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck uses various tutors and control elements to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Show and Tell and Bolas's Citadel provide alternate win conditions or powerful value plays. With a mix of efficient counterspells, ramp, and card advantage, this control deck aims to outvalue and disrupt the opponent while setting up game-winning combos.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It includes cards for card selection and drawing, as well as counterspells to protect the combo. The deck also features powerful cards like Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Time Walk to help set up the combo quickly. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently find and cast Doomsday, use it to set up a winning pile with Thassa's Oracle, and protect the combo with counterspells.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hatebear creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also deploying aggressive threats like Chancellor of the Annex and White Plume Adventurer. By utilizing cards like Trinisphere and Wasteland, the deck aims to slow down opponents and control the game. The inclusion of powerful removal spells like Solitude and Emeria's Call ensures that the deck can handle various threats. Overall, this deck aims to establish board presence while disrupting opponents' game plan, ultimately aiming to overpower them with its efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Shambling Shell using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. This allows you to bring back powerful creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam for free, while also triggering effects like Creeping Chill and Silversmote Ghoul. Using Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and consistent dredge combo.

This deck aims to assemble key combo pieces such as Tinker, Time Vault, and Coveted Jewel to generate a powerful advantage over the opponent. The deck utilizes fast mana acceleration through Moxen and Mishra's Workshop, while also including disruption elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo. The cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge help to dig for necessary pieces and generate additional card advantage. With the capability to potentially win the game in just a few turns, this deck is designed to quickly overwhelm and outpace the opponent in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly control the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Deathrite Shaman and Tarmogoyf. Utilizing disruptive spells such as Force of Will and Flusterstorm, along with mana denial from Wasteland and Strip Mine, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest provides additional control and card advantage, while also having access to versatile sideboard options like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor to handle various threats.

The deck focuses on creating infinite mana with cards like Grim Monolith and Tolarian Academy, then using Paradoxical Outcome to draw through the deck and eventually go off with Coveted Jewel to win the game. It also utilizes artifacts like Mana Crypt and Sol Ring for ramp, and powerful combo pieces like Mishra's Workshop and Time Vault. The deck also has disruption with cards like Force of Will and Trinisphere to help protect the combo. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble the pieces for a game-winning Coveted Jewel activation.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to loop powerful spells from the graveyard, which can generate a game-winning advantage. By combining fast mana sources like Moxen and Tolarian Academy with card draw and tutoring, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces for explosive plays. It also includes disruption in the form of counterspells and removal spells to protect the combo and control the game. The inclusion of powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk further enhances the deck's ability to close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and countermagic like Force of Will and Force of Negation. It also utilizes card draw and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Brainstorm to maintain advantage. By using powerful synergies between cards like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Gitaxian Probe, the deck aims to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent's life total with evasive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Wasteland to hinder the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo by utilizing powerful artifact cards such as Mishra's Workshop, Paradoxical Outcome, and Tinker. The goal is to generate mana quickly using cards like Grim Monolith and Moxen, and then use Coveted Jewel's ability to draw cards and gain control of the game. Karn, the Great Creator can also be used to fetch key artifacts like Time Vault and Trinisphere to further enhance the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast mana generation and card advantage to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Oath of Druids card to quickly bring out powerful creatures onto the battlefield. By using cards like Show and Tell, Tinker, and Flash, the deck aims to cheat out threats efficiently while also having a strong control package with cards like Force of Will and Counterspells. The deck also includes key cards like Bolas's Citadel for additional card advantage and Oko, Thief of Crowns for disruption and removal. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly ramping into powerful threats and controlling the game with counterspells and disruption.
